nodes.name: Has Credit Note Refund?
nodes.notes: True when the Zoho credit note carries a refund (creditnote_refunds / total_refund). False goes straight to the end, so invoice-only notes behave exactly as before.

nodes.name: Refund Configuration
nodes.notes: Bank 234 = 10210 Chase Bank 1316-C. Refund Method is intentionally not sent. Zoho production organization 884904251.

nodes.name: Get Credit Memo for Refund
nodes.notes: Reads back the credit memo just created, by external ID, to get its internal ID, customer, currency, subsidiary and remaining balance.

nodes.name: Prepare Credit Note Refund
nodes.notes: Builds the NetSuite Customer Refund body: document number Refund-<credit note number>, the Zoho refund amount and date, and an apply line tagging the refund to the credit memo.

nodes.name: Create Customer Refund
nodes.notes: Creates the Customer Refund and applies it to the credit memo in one call. External ID REFUND-<credit note number> stops a rerun from posting it twice.

nodes.name: Read Customer Refund After Creation
nodes.notes: Reads the refund back to capture its NetSuite ID, the document number NetSuite actually assigned, and the credit memo it is applied to.

nodes.name: Verify Customer Refund
nodes.notes: Confirms the refund exists, is applied to this credit memo, and reports the document number NetSuite assigned.
